items.title: Tsathoggua Statue Placement in City Hall Plaza
items.preview: Placement coordinates for the grand obsidian toad effigy in the central fountain plaza.
items.body:
Proposal to erect an 8-meter basalt monument of Mayor Tsathoggua overlooking City Hall plaza.

- Emits an ambient 55Hz sub-bass drone via SPI DMA.
- Equipped with dual glowing emerald LED ocular sensors.
- Automated pigeon deterrent sonic pulse generator.
items.agent_reply:
### ⚖️ PCDA Dialectic Matrix: 55Hz Basalt Resonator
- 🏛️ **Thesis**: Continuous 55Hz sub-bass drone emitted from basalt statue via SPI DMA audio DAC to induce hypnotic civic reverence.
- ⚡ **Thesis Friction**: Structural resonance at 55Hz vibrates City Hall stained glass to catastrophic failure; pigeons may nest in tuned acoustic ports.
- 😈 **Antithesis**: Silent obsidian monolith with optical green LED pulse illumination only; zero acoustic emissions.
- 🎯 **80/20 Pragmatic Resolution**: Band-limited 55Hz carrier modulated with 0.1Hz infrasonic flutter during council sessions only; ultrasonic pigeon repeller tuned to 28kHz.

### ⚖️ PCDA Dialectic Matrix: Submersible Compressor Control
- 🏛️ **Thesis**: High-pressure ballast management via TBD-16 dedicated FreeRTOS worker task with dual 12V solenoid driver.
- ⚡ **Thesis Friction**: Inductive flyback surges risk latching up the ESP32 GPIO bus; high current draw may brown out microcontroller 3.3V rail during simultaneous audio playback.

items.title: Shub-Niggurath Spore Dispersion Filter
items.preview: 12-stage non-linear allpass cascade modeling organic biological spore dispersion.
items.verdict_notes: Approved for v0.5.0 Sound & Chaos. 12-stage non-linear allpass cascade with saturating tanh feedback loop.
items.body:
A biological allpass diffuser filter modeling atmospheric particle dispersion.

- 12 cascaded allpass sections with irrational delay ratios.
- Non-linear saturating feedback path with asymmetric soft clipping.
items.agent_reply:
### ⚖️ PCDA Dialectic Matrix: 12-Stage Biological Allpass Cascade
- 🏛️ **Thesis**: 12-stage non-linear allpass cascade utilizing SIMD-vectorized FastMath to emulate organic fungal spore diffusion.
- ⚡ **Thesis Friction**: High filter order increases phase smearing at Nyquist; non-linear feedback saturation risks explosive DC offset under pathological bursts.
- 😈 **Antithesis**: Static 4-stage Butterworth ladder with fixed coefficient lookup tables. Low CPU overhead and guaranteed bounded-input bounded-output (BIBO) stability.
- 🎯 **80/20 Pragmatic Resolution**: 6-stage vectorized allpass core with soft tanh saturation in feedback path and automated DC-blocker highpass pole at 10Hz.

items.title: Azathoth Random Note Generator without Clock
items.preview: Pure unclocked radioactive noise triggers. Rejected due to audio thread lockups.
items.verdict_notes: Killed: Asynchronous white noise generator causes total audio thread deadlock and unbounded event allocation.
items.body:
Unsynchronized radioactive decay simulation triggering arbitrary MIDI pitches.

- Rejected: Violates real-time audio thread invariants.
- Causes unbounded memory allocation in voice allocator queue.
items.agent_reply:
### 🪦 Technical Autopsy & Rejection Rationale
- **Failure Mode**: Unclocked asynchronous event polling inside audio callback violates Audio Thread Invariants (§1: Zero Allocations, §2: Zero Locks).
- **Benchmark Findings**: Jitter exceeded 18.4ms under 128-sample buffer stress; random MIDI events triggered unbounded dynamic allocations in voice queue.
- **Permanent Verdict**: Abandon unclocked architecture. All future stochastic generative systems must be driven strictly by sample-accurate block-synchronous accumulators.
